Definition: probably akin to G1643 and the base of G1640; light, i.e. easy:--light.
BiblicalUsage: The word elaphrós carries the sense of light. In Matthew 11:30, the text says "For my yoke [is] easy."
TheologicalSignificance: I take elaphrós as it stands: light.
